en.commentary:
I put the Epson EcoTank ET-3950 at number one because it wins the only comparison in this category that changes your bank balance. Tested running costs land near 0.29 cents for a black page and 1.1 cents for a color page. A cartridge inkjet in the same size class runs closer to 10 cents a black page. Over the 4,000 pages a typical household prints across three years, that gap is worth several hundred dollars, which is more than the printer costs. Epson ships 8,500 black and 6,500 color pages of ink inside the box at 419.99 dollars, so the first two years of supply are already paid for on the day it arrives.

The second thing I rank on is a question almost nobody asks at checkout. Read the HP All-In Plan terms and you find that HP holds title to the printer, the cartridges and the ink bottles for the entire subscription. Cancel, or upgrade, and the hardware goes back to HP. That applies to Smart Tank models too, including after the three-year term ends. Cartridges are deactivated remotely once you cancel, even with ink still in them. California capped early cancellation fees at 30 percent of the contract obligation for new enrollments after July 31, 2026, which tells you how large those fees were getting. This belongs on the spec sheet next to print speed, so I scored it there.

The Brother HL-L2460DW sits at number two on one specific strength. Dry toner keeps its properties while the machine sits unused, so a household that prints twelve pages in March and nothing until August gets a clean first page every time. That is the actual usage pattern for most homes, and it is the pattern inkjets handle worst. At roughly 180 dollars with a 3,000-page high-yield cartridge available, it is the cheapest reliable answer for anyone printing plain black text.

One addition today, and it lands high. Brother's MFC-T780DW is the company's first serious supertank all-in-one, and it ships with roughly three years of ink in the box, close to 5,000 color pages before you buy a single bottle. Refills run $21 for black and $12.30 for each color, which puts its running cost inside EcoTank territory. Add an automatic document feeder, auto duplex, and the most stable wireless stack in the category, and $320 buys a machine that covers everything a household prints. I have it at number two.

highlights.title: Cost per page decides this category, and the spread is 40 to 1
highlights.body: The purchase price of a home printer is a rounding error next to what you spend feeding it. Epson's tested figures put the ET-3950 at about 0.29 cents per black page. A cartridge inkjet in the same class sits near 10 cents. Canon rates the G3270 for 6,000 black and 7,700 color pages on one set of bottles. Multiply any of those by the pages you actually print over three years and the ranking sorts itself. A 420 dollar supertank that costs 12 dollars to run for three years beats a 200 dollar cartridge machine that costs 400 dollars to run over the same period, and it is not close.

highlights.title: With HP's All-In Plan, HP owns the printer on your desk
highlights.body: HP's own FAQ states that HP retains ownership of the printer, the cartridges and the ink bottles throughout the subscription, and that all of it must be returned when you cancel or upgrade. Smart Tank subscribers are included, even after the three-year term completes. Cancelling also deactivates the cartridges remotely while ink remains inside them, so a cancellation means budgeting for supplies the same week. California legislated a 30 percent cap on early cancellation fees for new enrollments after July 31, 2026. I score ownership and exit cost as a first-class spec because it determines what you are left holding in year four.

highlights.title: If you print in bursts, buy dry toner
highlights.body: Households that print under ten pages a month are the majority, and that is the workload where a laser earns its place. Toner is a powder that sits stable for months, so the Brother HL-L2460DW and MFC-L2820DW start cleanly after a long gap and need no maintenance cycle to get there. Every inkjet in this list runs a cleaning routine that consumes ink to keep nozzles clear, which is ink you are paying for without printing a page. My rule is simple: under ten pages a month, buy the mono laser. Above 100 pages a month with color in the mix, buy the supertank.

highlights.title: Supply freedom is worth real money over a printer's life
highlights.body: The Brother lasers accept third-party toner and keep printing, which puts a competitive floor under what you pay per page for the next five years. Epson and Canon supertanks refill from open bottles, and a full replacement set typically runs under 70 dollars for thousands of pages. HP's HP+ setup path takes the other approach and locks the machine to genuine HP ink for its lifetime in exchange for a lower entry price and a free Instant Ink trial. That trade is worth understanding before you click through the setup wizard, because the choice is made once and it is permanent.

highlights.title: The 2026 price pressure moved from hardware to subscriptions
highlights.body: Tariff-driven supply increases have largely worked through the market. HP repriced supplies in November 2024 and raised Instant Ink monthly fees across every page tier in April 2025, with add-on page sets going from 1.00 to 1.50 dollars, a 50 percent jump. Epson lifted product pricing 3 to 4 percent in December 2025. The pattern for 2026 is that hardware and bottled supplies have stabilized while the recurring plans keep climbing. So the number to evaluate now is the three-year total: the price on the box plus every monthly fee you will have paid by the end of year three.

zh-tw.commentary:
我把 Epson EcoTank ET-3950 放第一，理由很單純，它贏的是這個品類裡唯一會影響你戶頭數字的那一項。實測的每頁成本大約是黑白 0.29 美分、彩色 1.1 美分，同尺寸的匣式噴墨機黑白大概要 10 美分一頁。一般家庭三年印個 4,000 頁，這個差距換算下來就是好幾百美元，比機器本身還貴。而且 ET-3950 開箱附的墨水就有 8,500 頁黑白與 6,500 頁彩色，等於機器到手那天，前兩年的耗材已經先付清了。

第二個我拿來排序的東西，老實說多數人在結帳前根本不會問。把 HP All-In Plan 的條款讀完你會發現，訂閱期間印表機、墨水匣與墨水瓶的所有權都在 HP 手上，取消或升級的時候，這些東西要寄回 HP。Smart Tank 機種也一樣，就算三年約期跑完再取消也是這樣。取消之後墨水匣還會被遠端停用，裡面剩的墨水就用不到了。加州針對 2026 年 7 月 31 日之後的新申辦，把提前解約金上限訂在合約義務的三成，這條法規本身就說明了原本的解約金長成什麼樣子。這件事的重要性完全不輸列印速度，所以我把它列成獨立評分項。

Brother HL-L2460DW 排第二，靠的是一個很具體的優勢。乾碳粉放著不會變質，家裡三月印十二張、然後放到八月才又想印東西，它一開機第一張就是乾淨的。講白了，這才是台灣多數家庭真正的使用模式，報稅印個幾張、學校通知印個幾張，其餘時間就是擺著。這台大約美金 180，還能換 3,000 頁的高容量碳粉匣，只印黑白文字的話，它是最便宜又最不會出包的答案。

今天加一台，而且位置排得很前面。Brother MFC-T780DW 是他們第一台認真做的原廠連供複合機，開箱附的墨水官方講三年份，彩色大概 5,000 頁，等於機器搬回家之後，明年後年的耗材錢已經先付掉了。

補充墨水黑色一瓶約 21 美元、彩色一瓶 12.3 美元，換算下來每頁成本已經跟 EcoTank 站在同一條線上。

它還有自動進紙器、自動雙面，加上 Brother 一貫最穩的無線連線。說真的，台幣一萬上下就拿到一台功能全開的機器，對常在家列印報稅資料、小孩學校作業、蝦皮出貨單的人來說很划算。我把它放第二。

highlights.title: 每頁成本才是勝負關鍵，而且差距拉到 40 倍
highlights.body: 家用印表機的售價，跟你之後餵它耗材的錢比起來根本是零頭。Epson 實測 ET-3950 的黑白每頁成本大約 0.29 美分，同級匣式噴墨機大約 10 美分。Canon G3270 官方標示一組墨水可印 6,000 頁黑白與 7,700 頁彩色。把這些數字乘上你三年真正會印的頁數，排名自己就跑出來了。一台美金 420 的連供機三年耗材花你十幾塊美金，一台美金 200 的匣式機同樣三年要花掉四百塊，這個差距大到沒有討論空間。

highlights.title: 訂閱 HP All-In Plan 的話，桌上那台機器的所有權在 HP
highlights.body: HP 自己的 FAQ 寫得很清楚，訂閱期間印表機、墨水匣與墨水瓶的所有權都屬於 HP，取消或升級時要全部寄回。Smart Tank 的訂閱戶也適用，三年約期結束之後取消一樣要寄回。取消還會遠端停用墨水匣，就算裡面還有墨水也一樣，所以解約當週你就得再編一筆耗材預算。加州針對 2026 年 7 月 31 日之後的新申辦把提前解約金上限壓在三成。我把所有權與退出成本當成一級規格來評分，因為它決定第四年你手上還剩下什麼。

highlights.title: 印量少又不定時，就買乾碳粉的雷射機
highlights.body: 台灣家庭一個月印不到十張的其實佔多數，這種使用強度剛好是雷射機的主場。碳粉是粉末，放好幾個月狀態都穩定，所以 Brother HL-L2460DW 跟 MFC-L2820DW 隔很久再開機，第一張就印得乾淨，也不用跑什麼保養程序。這份榜單上所有噴墨機都會定期跑清潔循環把噴頭洗通，那些墨水是你花錢買的，卻沒有印出任何一張紙。我的判斷標準很簡單，一個月十張以下就買黑白雷射，一個月一百張以上而且會印彩色就買連供。

highlights.title: 耗材自由度在機器的一生裡值不少錢
highlights.body: Brother 的雷射機裝副廠碳粉照樣印，這等於幫你未來五年的每頁成本壓了一個天花板。Epson 與 Canon 的連供機用開放式墨水瓶補充，換一整組原廠墨水通常不到美金 70 塊，就能印好幾千頁。HP+ 走的是另一條路，用比較低的入手價與免費 Instant Ink 試用，換取這台機器終身只吃原廠墨水。這個交換條件值得你在跑設定精靈之前先搞清楚，因為它只選一次而且不能反悔。

highlights.title: 2026 年的漲價壓力從硬體轉到訂閱端
highlights.body: 關稅帶動的耗材漲價大致已經反映完畢。HP 在 2024 年 11 月重訂耗材價格，2025 年 4 月把 Instant Ink 各頁數級距的月費全面調高，加購頁數包從 1.00 美元漲到 1.50 美元，一口氣多五成。Epson 在 2025 年 12 月把產品價格拉高 3 到 4 個百分點。2026 年的走勢是硬體與瓶裝耗材趨於穩定，訂閱方案繼續往上爬。所以現在該算的數字是三年總支出，把包裝盒上的標價加上三年內會付掉的每一筆月費，一起算完再決定。

en.commentary: Printers were absent from IFA and I could not be happier about it, because this is a category where innovation has historically meant new ways to charge you for ink. The Epson EcoTank ET-3950 holds first at 9.3 for the single reason that matters: refillable tanks mean the cost per page collapses to almost nothing, and a bottle of ink lasts years for a household. The economics of that decision dwarf every other feature on a printer spec sheet. A cartridge printer that costs NT$2,000 will cost you NT$10,000 in ink over three years, and an EcoTank that costs NT$9,000 will cost you NT$1,000. Do that maths once and the ranking explains itself. The Brother MFC-T780DW at 9.1 is the better choice if you need a document feeder and heavy scanning, and Brother's driver support on macOS is the most reliable here. The Brother HL-L2460DW at 9.0 is the monochrome laser answer, and for a household that prints text and nothing else, laser is faster, cheaper and never dries out. That last point matters enormously in Taiwan, because an inkjet used twice a month clogs, and a laser printer sitting idle for six weeks starts instantly.

highlights.title: Run the three-year ink maths before anything else
highlights.body: A cheap cartridge printer costs several times its purchase price in ink within three years, and a tank printer costs a fraction of that. That single calculation settles this category, and it is why the ET-3950 holds 9.3.

highlights.title: Buy laser if you print text and print rarely
highlights.body: An inkjet used twice a month clogs, and a laser sitting idle for six weeks starts instantly. For a household printing documents only, the HL-L2460DW at 9.0 is faster, cheaper per page and far less frustrating.

highlights.title: Brother has the most reliable macOS drivers here
highlights.body: Driver support is where printer ownership quietly goes wrong, especially after an operating system update. Brother has the best record in this list, and that reliability is worth real money over a printer lifetime.

highlights.title: A category skipping IFA is a category that stopped extracting
highlights.body: Innovation in printers has historically meant new ways to charge for ink. No presence in Berlin means no new schemes this year, and buyers benefit from a market that has settled down.

en.commentary:
Home printers held steady and this ranking is built on an argument I want to restate clearly, because it contradicts how printers are sold.

The purchase price of a home printer tells you almost nothing about what it costs. The cost is in ink or toner, and the business model across most of this industry is to sell the hardware cheaply and recover the margin on consumables. A printer costing eighty dollars with cartridges costing forty dollars every two hundred pages costs several times more over three years than a printer costing three hundred dollars with refillable tanks.

That is why cost per page carries the heaviest weight here, and why the top of this ranking is dominated by tank based printers.

The Epson EcoTank ET-3950 holds first at 9.3 because refillable tanks deliver a cost per page an order of magnitude below cartridge printers, and Epson's ink is widely available. The Brother MFC-T780DW at 9.1 is the same principle with Brother's generally strong reliability record.

The Brother HL-L2460DW at 9.0 is the monochrome laser pick, and for a household whose printing is text documents, monochrome laser is often the correct answer that nobody suggests.

One note on idle reliability. Inkjet printers used infrequently can clog, and that failure mode is common in households printing a few pages a month. If that describes you, a laser printer avoids the problem entirely, because toner does not dry out. Match the technology to your actual usage pattern.

highlights.title: Purchase price tells you almost nothing about cost
highlights.body: The industry model is cheap hardware and expensive consumables. A printer costing eighty dollars with cartridges at forty dollars per two hundred pages costs several times more over three years than a three hundred dollar printer with refillable tanks. Calculate cost per page and multiply by your annual volume before comparing sticker prices, because that arithmetic reverses the ranking almost every time.

highlights.title: Infrequent printing points to a laser printer
highlights.body: Inkjet printers used a few pages a month can clog, and unclogging wastes ink or requires service. Toner does not dry out, so a laser printer avoids that failure mode entirely. If your household prints occasional text documents, the Brother HL-L2460DW at 9.0 is the correct answer, and it is the one almost nobody suggests because photo capability dominates the marketing.

highlights.title: Epson EcoTank ET-3950 leads on cost per page
highlights.body: At 9.3 refillable tanks deliver a cost per page an order of magnitude below cartridge printers, and Epson's ink is widely available at retail. For a household printing regularly, the higher purchase price is recovered within the first year and everything after that is saving. This is the printer I recommend most often and the one buyers hesitate over because of the upfront number.

highlights.title: Match the technology to what you actually print
highlights.body: Photos need inkjet. Text documents are cheaper and more reliable on laser. Households that print school work, forms and shipping labels are buying photo capability they will use twice a year. Write down what you printed in the last six months before you shop, because that list determines which half of this ranking is relevant to you.

zh-tw.commentary:
家用印表機維持不動，而這份排名建立在一個我想再說清楚一次的論點上，因為它跟印表機的販售方式相牴觸。

一台家用印表機的購買價格，幾乎完全不告訴你它要花你多少錢。成本在墨水或碳粉上，而這個產業大部分的商業模式，就是硬體便宜賣、在耗材上把毛利賺回來。一台八十美元、每兩百頁要換四十美元墨水匣的印表機，三年下來的花費是一台三百美元、可加墨連續供墨機器的好幾倍。

這就是每頁成本在這裡權重最重的原因，也是這份排名頂端被連續供墨機型佔滿的原因。

Epson EcoTank ET-3950 以 9.3 守住第一，因為可加墨墨水槽交出的每頁成本比墨水匣印表機低一個數量級，而 Epson 的墨水到處買得到。Brother MFC-T780DW 的 9.1 是同樣的原理，加上 Brother 一貫紮實的可靠度紀錄。

Brother HL-L2460DW 的 9.0 是黑白雷射的選擇，而一個主要印文字文件而非照片的家庭，黑白雷射常常是那個沒人會建議的正確答案。

一個關於閒置可靠度的提醒。使用頻率低的噴墨印表機會塞頭，而那個失敗模式在一個月只印幾頁的家庭裡很常見。這如果在講你，雷射印表機完全避開了這個問題，因為碳粉不會乾掉。把技術配到你實際的使用模式上。

highlights.title: 購買價格幾乎完全不告訴你成本
highlights.body: 這個產業的模式是硬體便宜、耗材昂貴。一台八十美元、每兩百頁四十美元墨水匣的印表機，三年下來的花費是一台三百美元連續供墨機的好幾倍。比牌價之前，先算每頁成本再乘上你的年印量，因為那個算式幾乎每一次都會把排序翻過來。

highlights.title: 印得少就指向雷射印表機
highlights.body: 一個月只印幾頁的噴墨印表機會塞頭，而清洗噴頭會浪費墨水或需要送修。碳粉不會乾掉，所以雷射印表機完全避開那個失敗模式。你家如果偶爾印一下文字文件，9.0 的 Brother HL-L2460DW 就是正確答案，而它幾乎沒有人會建議，因為照片能力主宰了行銷。

highlights.title: Epson EcoTank ET-3950 靠每頁成本領先
highlights.body: 9.3 的可加墨墨水槽交出的每頁成本，比墨水匣印表機低一個數量級，而 Epson 的墨水在通路上到處買得到。一個會固定列印的家庭，較高的購買價格在第一年之內就回收，之後全部都是省下來的。這是我推薦次數最多的印表機，也是買家因為前期數字而猶豫的那一台。

highlights.title: 把技術配到你實際會印的東西上
highlights.body: 照片需要噴墨。文字文件在雷射上更便宜也更可靠。印學校作業、表格與寄件標籤的家庭，買的是一年會用兩次的照片能力。開始逛之前先寫下你過去六個月印過什麼，因為那份清單決定了這份排名的哪一半跟你有關。

en.commentary:
Epson EcoTank ET-3950 holds first at 9.3 and my position on this category has been consistent for years: buy the printer with the cheapest ink, because ink is where printer companies make their money and where owners lose theirs. A refillable tank system costs more at purchase and dramatically less across the years you own it.

Brother INKvestment Tank MFC-T780DW at 9.1 applies the same logic with Brother reliability, and Brother HL-L2460DW at 9.0 is my recommendation for anyone printing text only. A monochrome laser costs little, runs for thousands of pages per toner cartridge, and never clogs from disuse, which is the failure mode that kills most household inkjets.

That last point deserves emphasis. If you print twice a month, an inkjet will clog and you will spend more on cleaning cycles than on printing. Buy a laser. The decision is that simple and almost nobody makes it correctly.

EcoTank ET-2980 at 8.9 is the budget tank option for households that print in colour regularly enough to keep the heads healthy. Match the technology to your actual printing frequency and this category stops being frustrating.

highlights.title: Buy the printer with the cheapest ink
highlights.body: Purchase price is the small number and ink is the large one. Refillable tank systems cost more at the till and dramatically less across the years you own the machine.

highlights.title: Print twice a month? Buy a laser
highlights.body: Infrequent use clogs inkjet heads, and cleaning cycles consume more ink than the printing does. A monochrome laser runs thousands of pages and survives months of neglect.

highlights.title: Match technology to your printing frequency
highlights.body: Regular colour printing keeps tank heads healthy and justifies an EcoTank. Occasional text printing wants a laser. Getting this one decision right removes most printer frustration.

highlights.title: Brother earns its place on reliability
highlights.body: The INKvestment Tank combines low running costs with the build record that has made Brother the quiet recommendation among people who fix printers for a living.

zh-tw.commentary:
Epson EcoTank ET-3950 守第一，9.3 分，我在這個品類的立場好幾年沒變：買墨水最便宜的那台，因為墨水是印表機公司賺錢的地方，也是使用者賠錢的地方。

可填充的墨水匣系統，購買當下比較貴，攤到你擁有它的那幾年就便宜得驚人。

Brother INKvestment Tank MFC-T780DW 的 9.1，用 Brother 的可靠度套用同一套邏輯。Brother HL-L2460DW 的 9.0，是我給「只印文字」的人的推薦。單色雷射機身便宜，一支碳粉匣跑幾千頁，而且放著不用也不會塞住噴頭，那正是殺死多數家用噴墨機的死因。

最後這點值得加重語氣。如果你一個月印兩次，噴墨機會塞，你花在清潔循環上的墨水會比印出來的還多。買雷射。事情就這麼簡單，而幾乎沒有人做對這個決定。

EcoTank ET-2980 的 8.9，是給彩色印得夠頻繁、能維持噴頭健康的家庭的平價填充選擇。讓技術對上你真實的列印頻率，這個品類就不再讓人火大了。

highlights.title: 買墨水最便宜的那台
highlights.body: 機身價是小數字，墨水才是大的。可填充式的墨水系統結帳時貴一點，攤到使用年限便宜得驚人。

highlights.title: 一個月印兩次？買雷射
highlights.body: 低頻使用會塞住噴墨頭，清潔循環吃掉的墨水比列印本身還多。單色雷射跑得動幾千頁，放著幾個月也活得好好的。

highlights.title: 讓技術對上你的列印頻率
highlights.body: 規律的彩色列印能維持墨水槽噴頭健康，這時 EcoTank 才成立。偶爾印文字就該買雷射。這一個決定做對，印表機的煩躁就消掉大半。

highlights.title: Brother 的位置是可靠度換的
highlights.body: INKvestment Tank 把低運轉成本跟 Brother 的耐用紀錄結合起來，而那份紀錄正是修印表機維生的人私下會推薦它的原因。
